{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "jeanpablojp",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK; raised objections on edge cases which author resolved"
    },
    {
      "login": "achow101",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "objects to storing multipath descriptor strings instead of reconstructing from descriptor objects"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:3905364971",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Multiple multipath descriptors sharing an expanded descriptor causes ambiguous/arbitrary mapping",
      "quote": "<0;1> and <0;2> are different policies that share their /0/* expansion, so one descriptor can sit in two records and this hands back whichever the map reaches first.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author prevented sharing in rc:3907144679",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3905999298",
        "rc:3907144679"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3907144679",
      "status_by_quote": "This is now prevented."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3905364980",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Failed write on setup leaves wallet created reporting success without storing the multipath record",
      "quote": "Dropped here, a failed write leaves the wallet created and reporting success with no record, and the transaction wrapping wallet setup never learns of it.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "added missing handling and [[nodiscard]] in rc:3907145945",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3907145945"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3907145945",
      "status_by_quote": "Added the missing handling and a [[nodiscard]]."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3905364989",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Inconsistent hardened derivation marker representation ('h' vs ''') between desc and multipath",
      "quote": "The origin comes through as typed here when the key is an xpub, and normalized when it's the xprv, so desc and multipath can end up disagreeing on 84h versus 84' for the same key.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "fixed multipath normalization to always use h in rc:3907148929",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3907148929"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3907148929",
      "status_by_quote": "Good catch, fixed multipath normalization to always uses h."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5503486189",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Storing multipath descriptor strings and making Parse return strings instead of reconstructing multipath from descriptor objects is the wrong architecture",
      "quote": "My suggestion was not to store an extra record, but rather an extra field in WalletDescriptor which contains the ids of the other descriptors in the multipath. Reconstructing the multipath can be done",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author declined to implement alternative architecture and plans to close the PR",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5508760340",
        "c:5676525474",
        "c:5831748997"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5831748997",
      "status_by_quote": "I'm going to leave that for someone else to implement."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "r:5079561909",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "Supports the approach of storing multipath descriptor records in the wallet",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "author",
      "what": "closing PR once CI passes",
      "id": "c:5831748997"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Author pushed a final rebase for downstream use, declined to implement achow101's proposed architecture, and announced intent to close the PR once CI is green."
}
